study: Wright et al. 2020 (NIESR/BIT eval), URLEY (Oxford/UCL) early-years language PD, EEF
eval_evidence: EEF efficacy trial independently evaluated by NIESR and the Behavioural Insights Team (BIT); the URLEY programme was developed and delivered by a separate Oxford/UCL team.
developer_evidence: 'The intervention was developed and delivered by a team from Oxford University, University College London' (exec summary, p.5); the five core training days were delivered by the developer team.
cascade_evidence: Participating nursery/reception teachers attended the URLEY developer team's training days directly. (Trained mentors gave in-school support and teachers were expected to cascade to other classroom staff, but the PD-receiving teacher was trained directly by the developers.)
counterfactual_evidence: Two-arm cluster RCT testing URLEY 'compared to business as usual in control schools' (exec summary, p.5); control schools continued usual provision.
coaching_evidence: Each school received on average ~17.5 hours of mentoring (face-to-face + skype/phone) and ~3 days of in-class mentoring/coaching across the two-year programme — periodic/light support, not recurring monthly+ in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: URLEY changes teacher/classroom practice (language pedagogy + Environment Rating Scales); no tutoring, pull-out, extra child instructional minutes, or student-facing software dose.
maturity_evidence: Defined two-year programme (training Feb 2018 onward; post-test Jun-Jul 2018, end of trial) delivered once to schools new to URLEY; no recurring annual rollout / no prior implementation-year maturity wave.
